import json
from driver import run
from brute import brute_truth
from validate_witness import validate

INP = [[[ 3 ]]]  # P=1, R=1, D=1

def st(row, slots=None):
    return {"delivered": [row], "slots": slots or []}

NOT_DONE = st([])      # rank 0, no results yet
DONE = st([[3]])       # rank 0 with the correct result

def check(name, states, edges, start, fair, exp_term, exp_safe=None):
    req = {"op":"audit","inputs":INP,"states":states,"edges":edges,
           "start":start,"fairness":fair}
    got, _ = run(json.dumps(req))[0], None
    P = len(INP); R = len(INP[0]); D = len(INP[0][0]) if R else 0
    et = brute_truth(P, R, D, INP, states, [tuple(e) for e in edges], start,
                     [(f["action"], f["mode"]) for f in fair])[1]
    es = brute_truth(P, R, D, INP, states, [tuple(e) for e in edges], start,
                     [(f["action"], f["mode"]) for f in fair])[0]
    errs = validate(P, R, D, INP, states, [tuple(e) for e in edges], start,
                    [(f["action"], f["mode"]) for f in fair], got)
    ok = (got["terminates"] == exp_term == et) and (got["safe"] == es) and not errs
    if exp_safe is not None:
        ok = ok and got["safe"] == exp_safe
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name,
          "| terminates=%s (exp %s, truth %s)" % (got["terminates"], exp_term, et),
          "| safe=%s (truth %s)" % (got["safe"], es),
          "| resp=%s" % (json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),), "| errs=%s" % (errs,))
    return ok

ok1 = check("wholeSCC-trap",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"a",1],[1,"a",0],[0,"x",2]], 0,
     [{"action":"x","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=False)

ok2 = check("weak-stall",
     [NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"stall",0],[0,"go",1]], 0,
     [{"action":"go","mode":"weak"}], exp_term=True)

ok3 = check("strong-vacuous",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"stall",0],[0,"go",1],[1,"stall2",1],[1,"go",2]], 0,
     [{"action":"go","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=False)

ok4 = check("strong-live",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"stall",0],[0,"go",1],[1,"go",2]], 0,
     [{"action":"go","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=True)

ok5 = check("no-fairness-stall",
     [NOT_DONE, DONE], [[0,"go",1]], 0, [], exp_term=False)

ok6 = check("done-start",
     [DONE, NOT_DONE], [[0,"a",1],[1,"a",0]], 0,
     [{"action":"a","mode":"weak"}], exp_term=True)

ok7 = check("mixed-fair-subcycle",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"f",1],
      [1,"f",2],[1,"h",0],
      [2,"g",3],[2,"f",0],
      [3,"h",1],[3,"f",0],[3,"g",0],
      [0,"x",4],[1,"x",4],[2,"x",4],[3,"x",4]], 0,
     [{"action":"f","mode":"strong"},{"action":"g","mode":"strong"},
      {"action":"x","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=False)

# weak fairness satisfied by occasional disabling (state 3 has neither enabled)
ok8 = check("weak-occasional-disable",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"a",1],[1,"b",2],[2,"a",3],[3,"a",1],
      [1,"q",4],[2,"q",4]], 0,
     [{"action":"a","mode":"weak"},{"action":"b","mode":"weak"}], exp_term=False)

# two separate cycles sharing a hub: fair run alternates to satisfy two
# strong actions that each need an edge
ok9 = check("figure-eight",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"p",1],[1,"p",0],[0,"q",2],[2,"q",0],[0,"z",3]], 0,
     [{"action":"p","mode":"strong"},{"action":"q","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=False)

# strongly fair action whose only edges leave for done; cycle is a big SCC
# that a naive heuristic would prune entirely
ok10 = check("prune-inside-scc",
     [NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, NOT_DONE, DONE],
     [[0,"a",1],[1,"a",2],[2,"a",0],[1,"b",3],[2,"b",3]], 0,
     [{"action":"b","mode":"strong"}], exp_term=False)

print("all:", all([ok1,ok2,ok3,ok4,ok5,ok6,ok7,ok8,ok9,ok10]))
PYEOF
